name: mutl3y-review-workflow
description: Team-based code review workflow with distributed coordinator architecture. Orchestrates scouts, builders, gatekeepers, and probes through a 7-phase cycle (Discovery → Grade → Persist → Investigate → Decide → Implement → Validate → Close). Supports cost-optimized, balanced, and maximum-validation modes with automatic model tier escalation. Use /mutl3y-start for new cycles, /mutl3y-continue for resuming, /mutl3y-mode for cost/accuracy trade-offs.

commands.name: mutl3y-audit
commands.description: Manual workflow monitor audit — check barrier readiness, artifact presence, plan/trace drift. Use when suspecting stalled phase or missing evidence. Example: '/mutl3y-audit' to verify Phase 5 completion.

commands.name: mutl3y-config
commands.description: Interactive configuration wizard — sets paths (plans, artifacts, logs), external agents (deep review, research, QA), and preferences (parallel execution, depth). Run once per workspace. Example: '/mutl3y-config' then follow prompts.

commands.name: mutl3y-continue
commands.description: Continue existing cycle from last checkpoint — resumes from execution-trace.yaml. Use after interruption or manual pause. Detects autopilot intent. Example: '/mutl3y-continue' or '/mutl3y-continue keep going until done'.

commands.name: mutl3y-escalate
commands.description: Force escalation to strategy coordinator — bypasses tactical/execution layers for high-stakes decisions (closure, phase transition, expensive model approval). Example: '/mutl3y-escalate need to decide if we close or continue'.

commands.name: mutl3y-mode
commands.description: Switch workflow mode — balanced (0.8-0.9x cost, smart escalation), cost-optimized (0.6-0.7x cost, free tier max), or maximum-validation (1.5-1.8x cost, thoroughness first). Takes effect next cycle. Example: '/mutl3y-mode cost-optimized'.

commands.name: mutl3y-mode-status
commands.description: Show current mode and cost estimate — displays coordinator tiers, Phase 1.5 settings, worker model assignments, estimated cost vs baseline, false negative risk. Example: '/mutl3y-mode-status'.

commands.name: mutl3y-mode-wizard
commands.description: Interactive mode selection with cost/accuracy explanations — shows detailed cost breakdown per coordinator/worker, risk levels, use case recommendations. Use for informed mode switching. Example: '/mutl3y-mode-wizard'.

commands.name: mutl3y-paths
commands.description: Configure paths only — sets plans directory, artifacts pattern, gate logs location. Quick setup without full wizard. Example: '/mutl3y-paths' to reconfigure after repo restructure.

commands.name: mutl3y-reload-config
commands.description: Reload configuration from .mutl3y-config.yaml — refreshes in-memory settings after manual YAML edits. Use after external config changes. Example: '/mutl3y-reload-config'.

commands.name: mutl3y-reset
commands.description: Reset to defaults — restores balanced mode, default paths (docs/plan/), clears custom agent assignments. Use to undo problematic configuration. Example: '/mutl3y-reset'.

commands.name: mutl3y-reviewers
commands.description: Select external reviewer agents — choose deep review (Gilfoyle/gem-reviewer/Principal), research (gem-researcher/Explore), and QA agents. Use after installing new agent plugins. Example: '/mutl3y-reviewers'.

commands.name: mutl3y-start
commands.description: Start new review cycle — initiates Phase 0 discovery with strategy coordinator. Detects autopilot intent ('keep going', 'iterate until done'). Creates plan under docs/plan/. Example: '/mutl3y-start target: scanner_core/' or '/mutl3y-start keep going until done'.

commands.name: mutl3y-status
commands.description: Show current configuration and cluster state — displays mode, paths, agents, coordinator tiers, Phase 1.5 settings, active cycle (if any), last updated timestamp. Example: '/mutl3y-status'.
